note: 라벨은 프롬프트 판본에 상대적이다. 명세가 바뀌면 라벨을 재검토해야 하므로 그 해시를 여기 박는다 — 조용히 진리가 재정의되는 대신 검사가 터진다.

spec_rules.authoring: asks to create scenarios OR to add more coverage
spec_rules.bugreport: A bug report is never offtopic
spec_rules.corrects: The fact corrects, completes, or contradicts a scenario
spec_rules.edit: edit ONE scenario the user points at
spec_rules.merge: MERGE two or more existing scenarios into one
spec_rules.offtopic: no connection to this game or this project at all
spec_rules.position: point at a place inside a scenario
spec_rules.question: asking ABOUT the run or cases
spec_rules.split: SPLIT one existing scenario into several
spec_rules.statement: A STATEMENT ABOUT THE GAME IS A REQUEST
